title: Mang Den plateau day
summary: Dak Ke lake in the morning and Kon Pring in the afternoon. Pa Sy is about 9 km from town if you add the fall. Adults pay 50,000 VND there from 30 May 2026. Việt Úc Tourist still prints the older 20,000 VND gate.

stops.name: Dak Ke Lake
stops.note: Shore walk while the air is still cool. The gate fee is Check on arrival.

stops.name: Kon Pring village
stops.note: Communal house and gong culture on Highway 24. Ask before photos inside the rong house.

seoTitle: One day on the Mang Den plateau
seoDescription: A Mang Den day at Dak Ke lake and Kon Pring village. Pa Sy waterfall is about 9 km from town, with an adult gate of 50,000 VND from 30 May 2026.
